documents.title: JPM Presents Plans to Expand Its Product Portfolio, Specialized Manufacturing, Partnerships and Technology Transfer During a JFDA Visit to Its Umm Al-Amad Plant
documents.content: JPM presented plans to expand its product portfolio, specialized injectable and biological manufacturing, strategic partnerships and technology transfer during a JFDA visit to its Umm Al-Amad plant.
documents.summary: JPM outlined ambitious expansion plans including specialized manufacturing capabilities and strategic partnerships.
documents.source: Petra / Jordan Food and Drug Administration

documents.title: JPM Reports Continued Growth in Sales and Profitability for the First Half of 2026
documents.content: JPM reports continued growth in sales and profitability for the first half of 2026, recording net sales of JOD 13.78 million and net profit after tax of JOD 2.61 million.
documents.summary: JPM achieved strong financial results with net sales of JOD 13.78 million and net profit of JOD 2.61 million in H1 2026.

documents.title: JPM Approves First Cash Dividend in Over a Decade
documents.content: At the Annual General Meeting held on 1 April 2026, JPM approved a cash dividend equal to 4% of the Company's capital. The dividend was approved following the review of the Company's financial statements for the year ended 31 December 2025.
documents.summary: JPM shareholders approved a 4% cash dividend at the AGM on 1 April 2026, marking the first dividend in over a decade.
documents.author: CEO Abdulhamid Sinokrot

documents.title: JPM Welcomes British Ambassador and Academic Delegation
documents.content: The Jordanian Pharmaceutical Manufacturing Company welcomes the British Ambassador and a delegation from Hashemite University, honors its management team and discusses opportunities for joint research and technology transfer.
documents.summary: JPM received a visit from the British Ambassador and Hashemite University delegation to explore research collaboration.

documents.title: JPM Increases Capital to JOD 45.4 Million
documents.content: JPM increases its capital to JOD 45.4 million through the capitalization of debts owed to its main shareholder, Dr. Abduljabbar Al-Kubaisi, and through a share premium, strengthening the company's financial position.
documents.summary: JPM completed a capital increase to JOD 45.4 million in October 2025 to strengthen financial position.

documents.title: Our Business
documents.metaDescription: Learn about JPM innovative manufacturing operations in branded generics, natural products, biotech diagnostics and drug delivery systems.
documents.content: JPM is an innovative manufacturing company operating in diversified sectors within the healthcare industry. It was established in 1978 as a brand-generic developer and producer. JPM operations span: Core branded generic pharmaceutical business, Natural products through Delass subsidiary, Biotech diagnostics through AraGen subsidiary, Novel excipients and drug delivery systems through Suwagh subsidiary.

documents.title: Mission, Vision & Values
documents.metaDescription: Discover JPM mission to enable quality healthcare, our vision for developing markets, and our core business values.
documents.content: We enable quality health care for all people, through diversified and innovative contributions to the global health care industry. JPM believes in quality, creativity and innovation, entrepreneurship, loyalty to healthcare in developing communities, education, equality, and transparency.
documents.breadcrumb: Home › About JPM › Mission, Vision & Values

documents.title: Innovation Model
documents.metaDescription: Understand how JPM capitalizes on innovation through dedicated research, spin-outs, and commercialization.
documents.content: JPM has adopted a modern business model with four key steps: Dedicated research facility, Focused research teams, Spin-out, and Commercialization. This approach minimizes risk while maximizing return on innovation investment.

documents.title: Technology Transfer
documents.metaDescription: Learn about JPM technology transfer services and partnerships with manufacturers across multiple countries.
documents.content: JPM offers complete technology transfer services including personnel training, system development, engineering counsel, and strategic partnerships. JPM has conducted over 25 technology transfer services for manufacturers in Europe, Middle East, North Africa and Africa.

documents.title: Worldwide Presence
documents.metaDescription: JPM products are represented in more than 35 markets across Middle East, North Africa, Europe and Africa with expansion plans.
documents.content: JPM markets span Middle East (Jordan, Saudi Arabia, Syria, Qatar, Iraq, UAE, Oman, Yemen, Lebanon), North Africa (Egypt, Libya, Algeria, Tunisia, Sudan), Europe (Bosnia, Moldova, Belarus), Sub-Saharan Africa (Eritrea, Uganda, Mozambique), and upcoming expansion to Russia, South Africa, Germany.

documents.title: Product Finder
documents.metaDescription: Find JPM pharmaceutical products, natural products and diagnostic kits by category, brand name or generic name.
documents.content: JPM pharma has an excellent product portfolio and a rich pipeline which continues to grow. We deliver high-quality, affordable generic and patented medicines to patients. Search and filter products by brand or generic name, category and product type.

documents.title: Scientific Publications
documents.metaDescription: Our innovation means a strong track record of publication in peer-reviewed journals, contributing to scientific advancement.
documents.content: JPM's innovation track record includes publications in peer-reviewed journals. Browse our scientific papers, book chapters, and books covering drug delivery, pharmaceutical formulations, and diagnostic technologies.

documents.title: Patents
documents.metaDescription: Browse JPM registered patents in drug delivery, diagnostics, herbal formulations and pharmaceutical innovation.
documents.content: JPM holds more than 55 patents covering diverse areas including controlled-release drug delivery systems, rapid diagnostic devices, herbal formulations, and pharmaceutical excipients.

documents.title: Leadership
documents.metaDescription: Meet JPM Board of Directors and Executive Management team
documents.content: Meet the people who guide JPM's strategy and operations. JPM leadership includes the Board of Directors and Executive Management team bringing decades of experience in pharmaceutical manufacturing, innovation and business development.
